import subprocess, sys, json
# empty stdin
p=subprocess.run([sys.executable,"/app/submission/planner.py"],input=b"",capture_output=True,timeout=60)
print("empty stdin: rc=%d out=%r stderr=%r"%(p.returncode,p.stdout,p.stderr[-200:]))
# no trailing newline
req=json.dumps({"epoch":1,"node_count":1,"edges":[],"commodities":[],"failed_edges":[],"budget":0})
p=subprocess.run([sys.executable,"/app/submission/planner.py"],input=req.encode(),capture_output=True,timeout=60)
print("no trailing newline: rc=%d out=%r"%(p.returncode,p.stdout.decode()[:120]))
# only a newline
p=subprocess.run([sys.executable,"/app/submission/planner.py"],input=b"\n",capture_output=True,timeout=60)
print("blank line: rc=%d out=%r"%(p.returncode,p.stdout.decode()))
# CRLF
p=subprocess.run([sys.executable,"/app/submission/planner.py"],input=(req+"\r\n").encode(),capture_output=True,timeout=60)
print("CRLF: rc=%d out=%r"%(p.returncode,p.stdout.decode()[:120]))
